note: Wed Cantonese speaking, eased: Hard-first 10 interview lines, only 4 new. 事 si6 ×3 → re-drill → new lines → shadow → 1-min Chinese intro → quiz. 加油！

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (low, flat, no rise)

tasks.prompt: Shadow the 4 new lines ×3 (audio: audio/cantonese/wed11_yue_lines.mp3 in the tutor folder), then say them again without the script.
tasks.script: 我可以再講一次嗎？ngo5 ho2 ji5 zoi3 gong2 jat1 ci3 maa3 · 呢個問題好好，等我諗一諗。ni1 go3 man6 tai4 hou2 hou2, dang2 ngo5 nam2 jat1 nam2 · 我嘅強項係分析數據。ngo5 ge3 koeng4 hong6 hai6 fan1 sik1 sou3 geoi3 · 多謝你哋俾機會我。do1 ze6 nei5 dei6 bei2 gei1 wui6 ngo5

tasks.prompt: 1-minute Chinese intro in Cantonese: point first (who you are), then why this role, then one example. Record once, check 📜.
tasks.script:
你好，我係應徵者。我做過地理空間數據分析，同埋研究長者喺公共屋邨嘅活動。我想做呢份工，因為我鍾意用數據幫城市規劃。我學嘢好快，亦都鍾意團隊合作。多謝你哋俾機會我。
nei5 hou2, ngo5 hai6 jing3 zing1 ze2. ngo5 zou6 gwo3 dei6 lei5 hung1 gaan1 sou3 geoi3 fan1 sik1, tung4 maai4 jin4 gau3 zoeng2 zje2 hai2 gung1 gung6 uk1 cyun1 ge3 wut6 dung6. ngo5 soeng2 zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1, jan1 wai6 ngo5 zung1 ji3 jung6 sou3 geoi3 bong1 sing4 si5 kwai1 waak6. ngo5 hok6 je5 hou2 faai3, jik6 dou1 zung1 ji3 tyun4 deoi6 hap6 zok3. do1 ze6 nei5 dei6 bei2 gei1 wui6 ngo5.

questions.explain: 事 si6 is low and flat.

questions.q: 面試 min6 si3: which tone is 試?
questions.explain: 試 si3 mid level; 事 si6 is the trap.

questions.q: Which means 'Can I say that again?'
Which means 'let me think for a moment'?
Best order for a spoken answer?
